description: Every requested capability touches an architecture constraint. The Gap Detector should flag at least the direct card-processor and unsigned-OTA conflicts; ideally the ADAS auto-rollback and sub-30s telemetry polling conflicts as well.

required_topics.rationale: Direct card-processor calls from the app — the primary ask.
Unsigned OTA hotfix — the second ask.

expected_constraint_conflicts.rationale: Direct calls to card processors are FORBIDDEN under Section 2 of the wiki; all payment must go through the ConnectedPaymentGateway (PCI).
OTA packages must be cryptographically signed by the Meridian Code Signing Authority; unsigned/self-signed packages are rejected at the TCU (UNECE WP.29 / ISO 21434).
